selection_rule: Minimize mean development CD1_x100 averaged over 3 surface-sampling seeds. Require F1 >= baseline-0.0005, Precision >= baseline-0.0005, boundary_edge_fraction <= baseline+0.0002, and point-to-mesh SurfaceCD1_x100 <= baseline*1.01+1e-7. Baseline participates; tie prefers baseline. Freeze before any new-test evaluation.
